## Workload

During the review period, Hannah Lowe completed 527 reads, recording 248 hours of work. This represents an average of 2.1 reads per hour. The volume of work was considered alongside the time recorded, providing context for the review of both throughput and reading practice. The workload remained the main focus of the assessment, with the available information supporting a clear comparison between completed reads and hours worked.

## Quality

A sample of 48 reads was checked as part of the quality review. Agreement was recorded at 60.4 per cent. Feedback was provided on borderline background cases, with these cases identified for further attention in ongoing practice. The findings were discussed with Hannah Lowe, and the review was completed by Priya Anand. Overall, the review records the workload undertaken and the quality findings arising from the checked sample.
